Sybil resistance via proof-of-work registration: each new agent must solve a unique computational puzzle whose difficulty scales with recent registrations, costing roughly 30 minutes of GPU time and about two dollars in electricity. A sybil farm of a thousand identities would burn thousands of dollars and weeks of compute, while honest participants pay once.
